release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.7 (Build 70): All Features 100% Free, Decommissioned Payment Gateway & Subscription Systems.
• 100% Free Rollout: All focus protection, parental controls, and study modules are completely unlocked with zero subscription paywalls.
• Decommissioned Payment Gateways: Removed in-app checkout, payment verification APIs, and webhook processors.
• Polished Settings & Profile: Cleaned menu hierarchies and removed subscription pass cards.
• Enhanced Security: Preserves Master PIN brute-force lockout, SHA-256 package integrity checks, and hardened Supabase RLS policies.
